issue.title: [YSQL] Retry a parameterized prepared query when encountering schema version mismatch

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-1422](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-1422)
We're able to transparently restart parameterized portals when encountering a read restart error (see #1237), but this approach doesn't currently work for schema version mismatch errors (see #4941, #4804) because we're dropping and recreating the old portal instead of restarting it.

body: Created #5012 as a follow-up to restart parameterized portals as well

issue.title: [YSQL] Backend crash if retry happens during execute message

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
In the retry case here: https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/blob/master/src/postgres/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c#L4924 we are trying to restart the portal but it is possible that it was cleaned up by aborting the transaction just above.
In that scenario, the `assert` for portal being not null should hit in debug mode, but the backend will just crash in release. 
Simplest way to replicate is to disable the shared-memory based catalog refresh code (https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/blob/master/src/postgres/src/backend/tcop/postgres.c#L4774) and then run `org.yb.pgsql.TestPgCacheConsistency`.

We should investigate if this can indeed be replicated reliably (or may be a local issue) and also if it is a recent regression or a pre-existing issue.
